##### Project general facts

DWTN Residences is a landmark residential development that redefines vertical living through a unique concept of six dedicated lifestyle ecosystems integrated throughout the tower. The project comprises a limited collection of 432 exclusive residences and 90 signature residences, including one- to three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and an ultra-exclusive royal palace. The architectural concept transforms a traditional residential tower into a self-contained vertical community, where each ecosystem is designed to support different aspects of daily life. Particular attention has been given to spatial planning, natural light, and the seamless flow between living spaces, creating residences that combine functionality with contemporary sophistication.

The development offers more than 75,000 square feet of amenities distributed across multiple levels of the tower. These lifestyle ecosystems are designed to support wellness, recreation, social interaction, business activities, relaxation, and entertainment. Residents benefit from a comprehensive range of facilities that create dedicated environments for fitness, leisure, community engagement, professional needs, and private celebrations, providing a complete residential experience within a single development.

The residences feature premium materials and carefully executed interior finishes throughout. The design palette incorporates warm neutral tones, accents inspired by Gulf waters, and refined metallic details that contribute to a contemporary aesthetic. Kitchens are fully equipped with built-in appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern finishing with high-quality materials and a strong emphasis on craftsmanship, comfort, and visual refinement.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
